data.title: Denileukin diftitox
data.summary: Biologicals · Fusion protein of interleukin-2 and diphtheria toxin
data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Biologicals_

**Class:** Fusion protein of interleukin-2 and diphtheria toxin

## Mechanism of action
- The IL-2 part binds CD25 (IL-2 receptor) on malignant and activated T cells; the diphtheria toxin part enters the cell and stops protein synthesis → cell death

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Persistent or recurrent CD25-positive cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (originally approved 1999, withdrawn 2014; a new formulation was re-approved in the USA in 2024)

## Dose & formulations
- IV infusion daily for 5 days every 21 days (dose per product label)

## Adverse effects
- Capillary leak syndrome (oedema, hypoalbuminaemia, hypotension) — boxed warning
- Infusion reactions, visual loss (rare), hepatotoxicity, infections

## Contraindications
- Hypersensitivity; low albumin

## Pregnancy & lactation
Avoid.

## Viva points
- IL-2–diphtheria toxin fusion targeting CD25 in CTCL; capillary leak syndrome

_Sources: Khopkar (Immunobiologicals — denileukin diftitox); Wolverton 4e ch.37. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
